components.name: Primary Filled Button — Light
components.description: The single primary action on a light surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-light { display: inline-flex; min-width: 48px; min-height: 54px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #6E530F; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 16px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: filter 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary-light:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary-light:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary-light:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(81, 91, 131, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Primary Filled Button — Dark
components.description: The same scarce primary action resolved for a dark surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-dark { display: inline-flex; min-width: 48px; min-height: 54px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #E9C46A; color: #352A00; font: 600 16px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: filter 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(188, 198, 244, 0.5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: App Bar — Light
components.description: A flat standard app bar below the top safe area with one settings action.
components.css: .ds-appbar-light { min-height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 4px 0 16px; background: #F8F9FC; color: #101828; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-appbar-light strong { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-appbar-light button { width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: inherit; } .ds-appbar-light button:hover { background: #F1F3F8; } .ds-appbar-light button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(81, 91, 131, 0.45); } .ds-appbar-light svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: App Bar — Dark
components.description: The flat standard app bar resolved for the blue-charcoal appearance.
components.css: .ds-appbar-dark { min-height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 4px 0 16px; background: #111823; color: #F1F3F8; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-appbar-dark strong { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-appbar-dark button { width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: inherit; } .ds-appbar-dark button:hover { background: #171F2C; } .ds-appbar-dark button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(188, 198, 244, 0.5); } .ds-appbar-dark svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Listening Doorway — Light
components.description: The signature empty-state geometry on a light surface.
components.css: .ds-doorway-light { width: 250px; height: 280px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 36px 1fr; align-items: center; background: #F8F9FC; overflow: hidden; } .ds-doorway-panel { height: 86%; background: #DDE1EA; border: 1px solid #D7DAE2; } .ds-doorway-left { clip-path: polygon(12% 0, 100% 10%, 100% 90%, 12% 100%, 0 96%, 0 4%); } .ds-doorway-right { clip-path: polygon(0 10%, 88% 0, 100% 4%, 100% 96%, 88% 100%, 0 90%); } .ds-doorway-light i { width: 20px; height: 20px; justify-self: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #6E530F; animation: ds-marker-settle 280ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-marker-settle { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-doorway-light i { animation: none; } }

components.name: Listening Doorway — Dark
components.description: The same open listening space resolved for dark appearance.
components.css: .ds-doorway-dark { width: 250px; height: 280px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 36px 1fr; align-items: center; background: #111823; overflow: hidden; } .ds-doorway-panel { height: 86%; background: #303A49; border: 1px solid #3B4554; } .ds-doorway-left { clip-path: polygon(12% 0, 100% 10%, 100% 90%, 12% 100%, 0 96%, 0 4%); } .ds-doorway-right { clip-path: polygon(0 10%, 88% 0, 100% 4%, 100% 96%, 88% 100%, 0 90%); } .ds-doorway-dark i { width: 20px; height: 20px; justify-self: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #E9C46A; animation: ds-marker-settle 280ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-marker-settle { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-doorway-dark i { animation: none; } }

components.name: Book List Row
components.description: A flat native library row with cover, title, and author rhythm; the list tile owns its semantics.
components.css: .ds-book-row { min-height: 80px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #F8F9FC; color: #101828; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-book-row:hover { background: #F1F3F8; } .ds-book-row:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(81, 91, 131, 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-book-cover { width: 48px; height: 64px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; background: #DDE1EA; color: #4B557B; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-book-row strong, .ds-book-row span { display: block; } .ds-book-row strong { max-width: 30ch; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-book-row span { margin-top: 4px; color: #4B557B; font-size: 15px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like entering a calm room made for listening: cool semantic surfaces create stillness, tall slate planes suggest an open doorway, and one restrained brass marker signals the listening action. The system is premium and understated without becoming precious; book covers and user content are allowed to carry the personality while the surrounding interface recedes.

The visual language uses flat tonal layering, generous negative space, comfortable reading rhythm, and adaptive native behavior. Material 3 roles structure Android presentation, while iOS navigation and transitions retain familiar platform behavior. Expression belongs in the palette, measured geometry, and the signature listening marker—not in decorative gradients, excessive cards, or custom controls that compete with native expectations.
keyCharacteristics: Cool semantic surfaces in coordinated light and dark appearances.
One scarce brass accent for the primary listening marker and action.
Platform system typography with a calm, compact hierarchy.
Flat tonal layering, restrained corners, and no decorative shadow vocabulary.
Native navigation, controls, touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.

rules.name: The One Brass Voice Rule
rules.body: Brass belongs to the primary listening marker and primary action; its rarity is what makes it legible.

rules.name: The Reading Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Preserve semantic type roles and text scaling; never shrink or tighten copy merely to force a preferred composition.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Separate layers with tonal roles and spacing; do not add drop shadows to cards, app bars, doorway planes, or controls.

dos: Do use semantic Material color roles so light and dark appearances remain coordinated.
Do reserve brass for the primary listening marker, primary action, and necessary interactive emphasis.
Do keep content flows native, scrollable, safe-area aware, and resilient to text scaling.
Do use the spacing, radius, type, touch-target, and motion tokens already defined in the Flutter theme.
Do disable the listening-marker motion when reduced motion or accessible navigation is requested.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients, glass effects, arbitrary accent colors, or drop shadows.
Don't wrap empty states, settings groups, or list rows in generic cards.
Don't replace platform navigation, back behavior, segmented controls, list tiles, or progress indicators with web-shaped imitations.
Don't fabricate cover art, catalog content, a logo, or a final product name.
Don't stretch centered reading content across tablet widths or compress it to preserve a fixed phone composition.
